concept.description: The single concept the services disagree about

behavior_id.description: Optional at Stage 1 -- a discovery-agent candidate legitimately cannot know a Behavior ID that doesn't exist yet (REQ-31a assigns IDs downstream). Omit rather than guess; Stage 2 adjudication fills it in.

classification.description: policy = model as explicit domain variation; false-cognate = things that look like one concept but belong to different bounded contexts; defect = preserve, log, fix separately AFTER migration

confidence.description: Confidence that this is a genuine Divergence rather than a discovery-pass artifact. Same convention as behavior.schema.json (REQ-09, C10).

driving_dimension.description: What actually varies: channel, product, tenant, mechanism
